name: Add the life-contingent annuity EPV ä_x:n = ∑ vᵏ·ₖpₓ (survival-weighted)
description: Survival-weighted discrete life annuity-due ä_x:n, with nonnegativity, monotone decrease in i, and reduction to the certain annuity when survival is identically 1.

code.lean:
import MathFin.Actuarial.LifeAnnuityDue

open MathFin

/-- Survival-weighted discrete life annuity-due ä_x:n, with nonnegativity, monotone decrease in i, and reduction to the certain annuity when survival is identically 1. -/
theorem mf_actuarial_life_annuity_due (μ : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ i : ℝ, -1 < i → 0 ≤ lifeAnnuityDue μ x i n) ∧
    (∀ i₁ i₂ : ℝ, -1 < i₁ → -1 < i₂ → i₁ ≤ i₂ →
      lifeAnnuityDue μ x i₂ n ≤ lifeAnnuityDue μ x i₁ n) ∧
    (∀ i : ℝ, i ≠ 0 →
      (∀ k < n, survivalFromForce μ (x + (k : ℝ)) = survivalFromForce μ x) →
      lifeAnnuityDue μ x i n = (1 - (1 / (1 + i)) ^ n) / (1 - 1 / (1 + i))) :=
  MathFin.lifeAnnuityDue_basic_properties μ x n
